metadata.description: Export and import student learning progress data to/from Google Sheets using TDD approach. Tests written first, then implementation verified against tests.
metadata.notes: TDD workflow: (1) Foundation setup (US-001 to US-003), (2) Write ALL tests first (US-004 to US-008), (3) Implement components with tests verifying (US-009 to US-014). Each implementation story has 'All tests pass' as acceptance criteria.
